question: True or false: the Oakland Athletics of the Moneyball era won at least one World Series?
answer: False. Oakland reached the playoffs four years running, 2000 to 2003, and went out in the first round each time, every time in a deciding fifth game. A 162-game season lets skill show; a best-of-five series is a handful of games that luck can swing. The method won seasons, not short series.
move: A short series measures luck more than the method behind it.
ask: Am I judging a good method by a few results too small to show anything?
trap: Assuming a famous winning method must have brought a title.
reference: Sports Reference, Baseball-Reference.com, Oakland Athletics team history and postseason results, 2024
